name: atmospheric-soft-goth-selfie
image_purpose: goth makeup, hair, accessory, and close-up selfie reference

prompt.project_info: Create a chest-up close-up selfie of an approved adult woman with a soft-goth aesthetic in a simple indoor setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair, face-framing bangs, winged eyeliner, light contacts, reddish blush, reddish-brown lips, silver nose ring, black choker, pendant, and opaque black high-neck alternative top.
prompt.composition_elements: Slight low-angle phone selfie, direct intense gaze, white door and neutral wall background, sharp face and natural skin texture, small optional temporary upper-arm tattoo kept non-textual.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor light with minimal shadows, high contrast between dark styling and bright neutral background.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, portrait 4:5, chest-up, slight wide-angle perspective, sharp eyes, natural pores and fine hair detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair and face-framing bangs takes a close-up soft-goth selfie, wearing winged eyeliner, reddish blush, subtle reddish-brown lips, silver nose ring, black choker, pendant, and an opaque black high-neck top. Use a bright neutral indoor background, soft even light, natural skin texture, and intense direct gaze. No plunging neckline or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low-cut top, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized framing, nudity, distorted face, extra fingers, plastic skin, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
